messages.content: 4 روز کاری از شکایت گذشته پس چه غلطی دارید میکنید ؟ اعصاب منو بهم ریختین یه بسته تهران به تهران رو گند زدین به اعتبارتون

function.name: GET_PARCEL_STATE
function.description: Determines the current state of a parcel based on its tracking ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

parcelTrackingId.description: The unique identifier for the parcel, used to track its status.

includeHistory.description: Specifies whether to include the parcel's state history in the response.

function.name: submit_complaint
function.description: Submit a complaint for a user who is experiencing issues with parcel delivery, such as non-delivery or incorrect data entry. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

userName.description: The user's full name in Persian script.

userMobileNumber.description: The user's mobile number, expected to be in the format +[country code][number] (e.g., +989123456789).

parcelTrackingId.description: The unique tracking number of the parcel in question.

statement.description: A detailed description of the issue from the user's perspective.

function.name: GET_COMPLAINT_STATE
function.description: Retrieves the current state of a user's complaint using the complaint tracking ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

userMobileNumber.description: The mobile number of the user, formatted as a string without spaces or special characters (e.g., '1234567890').

complaintTrackingId.description: A unique identifier for the complaint, used to track the status of the complaint.

function.name: handover_to_agent
function.description: This function initiates a handover process to transfer the ongoing chat session from a virtual assistant to a human agent. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the human agent to whom the chat will be transferred.

session_id.description: The session identifier of the current chat that needs to be handed over.

priority.description: The priority level for the handover request.

message.description: An optional message from the virtual assistant to the human agent.

message.content:
متأسفم که تجربه‌تان رضایت‌بخش نبوده است. برای بررسی وضعیت شکایت یا ثبت شکایت جدید، لطفاً اطلاعات زیر را در اختیار ما قرار دهید: | فیلد | توضیح | |------|--------| | **نام کامل** (به فارسی) | نام و نام خانوادگی شما | | **شماره موبایل** | به صورت +۹۸۹۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹ | | **کد رهگیری بسته** | شماره پیگیری پارسل | | **موضوع شکایت** | یکی از گزینه‌های زیر:
• NON_DELIVERY
• PACKAGE_LOSS
• PACKAGE_DAMAGE
• LACK_OF_NOTIFICATION
• INAPPROPRIATE_BEHAVIOR
• ... (در صورت نیاز می‌توانید گزینه مناسب را انتخاب کنید) | | **بیان مشکل** (اختیاری) | توضیح مختصری درباره مشکلی که تجربه کرده‌اید | اگر قبلاً شکایتی ثبت کرده‌اید و فقط می‌خواهید وضعیت آن را بدانید، کافی است شماره موبایل و شناسه شکایت را بدهید. با تشکر از صبر و همکاری‌تان.
message.reasoning: The user is speaking in Persian. They say: "4 روز کاری از شکایت گذشته پس چه غلطی دارید میکنید ؟ اعصاب منو بهم ریختین یه بسته تهران به تهران رو گند زدین به اعتبارتون". Rough translation: "4 business days have passed since the complaint, so what mistake are you making? You messed up my nerves, you ruined a Tehran-to-Tehran package, to your credit." They are complaining about delay and damage. They want to know what mistake is being made. They might want to file a complaint or check status. We can ask for complaint tracking ID or we can submit a new complaint. The user didn't provide complaint ID. They might want to file a new complaint. We can ask for details: userName, userMobileNumber, parcelTrackingId, subject, statement. Or we can ask for complaintTrackingId to check status. But they are complaining about delay. So we can ask for complaintTrackingId if they have one. But they didn't provide. So we can ask them to provide details to file a complaint. We should respond in Persian. Provide a polite apology and ask for details.
